attacks.claim: QA and the beta never exercised the production Epic path. Epic ran on the dev sandbox and the Steam build sat on a private branch, yet both were pointed at the production backend. Sandbox EOS tokens come from a different deployment than production ones, so production EOS validation, linking and cabined-account detection are unproven for the 29% of players on Epic.
attacks.evidence: ABSENT: any production-deployment Epic test. 'Epic build 1.4.0-cl5521 on the Epic dev sandbox' / 'Epic sandbox testers (150)'

attacks.claim: 'Every replaced version is kept' conflicts with server retention of only the last 5 versions per slot. The artifact gives no upload cadence, dedup or rotation guard, so frequent syncs, up to 60 per hour, could push out every good version. That undermines the agreed rule that players must never lose a save. The server also never validates blobs, and the client checks the checksum only on load, not before upload.
attacks.evidence: 'the server keeps the last 5 versions per slot' / '60 uploads per hour per player' / 'The client verifies the save's checksum and v3 schema before loading'

attacks.claim: The conflict rule depends on a 'last sync' base that is never defined, and 'newest' relies on device-reported timestamps. Behavior after a reinstall, a 1.3 round trip or clock skew is unspecified.
attacks.evidence: 'If both changed since last sync, the game asks' / sidecar 'last-modified'

attacks.claim: The patch note 'Your saves on this PC stay where they are' is imprecise. A newer cloud copy is downloaded over the local slot without a prompt, though the old copy is kept in local backups.
attacks.evidence: 'downloads the newest cloud copy if the local slot is older'

attacks.claim: 'Unlink and delete' removes all server versions, including the Restore history, with no described confirmation or grace period.
attacks.evidence: 'removes the link and all server copies within 24 h'

attacks.claim: No alerts exist for silent save-loss signals such as unreadable-cloud-save events, blob rejections or version rotation.
attacks.evidence: 'Alerts: sync error rate > 2% for 15 min, API 5xx > 1%, any spike in restores > 3× the beta rate'

attacks.claim: Nothing major. Server-side token validation, per-player scoping and upload limits are described, and a cross-player access test returned 403.
attacks.evidence: 'Token from player A used on player B's slots | 403'

attacks.claim: Nothing major. The data collected is minimal, the policy is updated, and deletion is available. Retention of the link record itself is not stated.
attacks.evidence: 'Cloud data with no sync for 24 months is deleted'

attacks.claim: Nothing gate-worthy. The backend is the studio's own, and no export path is described.
Nothing gate-worthy. A 30k concurrent-launch load test is reported against a 182k MAU base.
attacks.evidence: '30k concurrent launches syncing in 10 min | p95 410 ms, 0 errors'

attacks.claim: Nothing gate-worthy. A billing alert, a hard stop and a forecast are provided.
attacks.evidence: 'Cloud billing alert at $250/month and hard project budget stop at $600/month'

attacks.claim: Nothing gate-worthy. Under-13 Epic accounts are handled, and Steam accounts require users aged 13 or older.
attacks.evidence: 'Epic under-13 (cabined) accounts ... linking is not offered'

attacks.claim: Nothing gate-worthy in the status and error copy.
Nothing gate-worthy. Controller-only, keyboard-only, 200% scale and narration were all tested.

attacks.evidence: 'Off until a player turns it on in Settings > Cross-Save'
'The game never blocks on the network'
'Save files are unchanged: same v3 format as 1.3'
